intent_en: To demonstrate the unequal distribution of vaccine doses globally, highlighting that high-income countries acquired the majority of supplies while lower-income countries received very few.
previous_intent: To illustrate the severe disparity in confirmed vaccine dose purchases across income levels, highlighting that high-income countries acquired the vast majority of doses while lower-income nations received minimal amounts.
narration_support: Basically, rich countries got vaccines. Poor countries didn't.
chart_support: Bar chart titled 'Confirmed Purchases of Vaccine Doses' comparing dose amounts across four income levels (High income, Upper middle income, Lower middle income, Lower income), showing a dramatic decrease in purchases as income level drops.
evidence_note: The narration provides a qualitative summary ('rich got vaccines, poor didn't') that is directly visualized by the bar chart's steep decline from High Income to Lower Income categories.
